name: Config error: a wrong-typed field outranks an invalid storage_mode value
description: Layer precedence: when a config has BOTH a wrong-TYPED root field and an invalid storage_mode VALUE, all three runtimes must report the type error. pine-go does so because encoding/json fails the whole unmarshal before any value check runs; the other two must place their whitelist after every root type check. This pins a gap that review found in the fix for another gap: moving pine-cpp's whitelist to parse time (so it would outrank operator errors) put it BETWEEN the storage_mode and log_prefix reads, so pine-cpp reported the value error where pine-go and pine-java reported log_prefix's type error — java != cpp, the one pairing that is supposed to be aligned. Neither the adjacent-pair ordering tests nor the other precedence fixture caught it: both use two wrong-TYPED fields, so they never mix the two layers.

expected_error.wrapping_exact: pine: config error: config field "log_prefix" must be a string
